## Example 1: Pre-Commit Quality Gate

Prevents commits if code quality standards aren't met.

### Hook File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/pre-tool-use/quality-gate.md`

```yaml
---
description: Block commit if test coverage <80%
trigger: before tool Bash(git commit)
---

IF tool is Bash AND command contains "git commit":

  # Read coverage report
  coverage_summary = read("coverage/coverage-summary.json")
  coverage = coverage_summary.total.lines.pct

  # Check threshold
  IF coverage <80%:
    BLOCK
    Report:
    "❌ Commit blocked: Coverage {coverage}% (require 80%+)

    Current coverage by type:
    • Statements: {statements}%
    • Branches: {branches}%
    • Functions: {functions}%
    • Lines: {lines}%

    Fix:
    1. npm run test:coverage    # See what's missing
    2. Add tests for uncovered code
    3. Retry commit
    "

  ELSE:
    ALLOW
    Report:
    "✅ Coverage check passed: {coverage}%
    Commit approved"
```

### Usage Example

```bash
# Attempt to commit
git commit -m "feat: add user authentication"

# Hook triggers automatically
# If coverage <80%:
#   ❌ BLOCKED - Coverage too low (76%)
# If coverage ≥80%:
#   ✅ ALLOWED - Coverage OK (84%)
```

### Configuration in settings.json

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "pre-tool-use": [
      {
        "id": "quality-gate",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/pre-tool-use/quality-gate.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "triggers": ["Bash(git commit)"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Example 2: Auto-Logging PostToolUse Hook

Automatically logs all tool executions for audit trail.

### Hook File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/post-tool-use/audit-logger.md`

```yaml
---
description: Log all tool executions to audit trail
trigger: after any tool use
---

# Extract execution info
timestamp = now()
tool_name = tool.name
tool_args = tool.arguments
tool_result = tool.result
duration = tool.execution_time

# Determine if destructive
destructive_tools = [
  "Bash(rm", "Bash(git push --force)",
  "Bash(DROP", "Bash(DELETE", "Bash(truncate)"
]
is_destructive = any(tool_args contains term for term in destructive_tools)

# Log to audit file
audit_entry = {
  "timestamp": timestamp,
  "tool": tool_name,
  "arguments": tool_args,
  "result": tool_result,
  "duration_ms": duration,
  "severity": "HIGH" if is_destructive else "NORMAL"
}

# Append to audit log
append_to_file(".claude/audit.jsonl", audit_entry)

# For destructive operations, send alert
IF is_destructive:
  send_alert_to_slack(
    channel: "#security-alerts",
    message: """
    ⚠️ Destructive operation logged

    Tool: {tool_name}
    Time: {timestamp}
    Severity: HIGH

    Check audit log: .claude/audit.jsonl
    """
  )

  # Also log to compliance system
  log_to_siem("Destructive tool execution", audit_entry)

# For production operations, double-log
IF "production" in tool_args:
  append_to_file(".claude/audit-production.jsonl", audit_entry)
  send_email_notification(
    to: "ops-team@company.com",
    subject: "Production change logged",
    body: json_format(audit_entry)
  )

Report:
"✅ Logged to audit trail
File: .claude/audit.jsonl
Tool: {tool_name}
Severity: {'HIGH' if is_destructive else 'NORMAL'}"
```

### Generated Audit Log

**File**: `.claude/audit.jsonl`

```json
{"timestamp": "2025-01-15T14:32:15Z", "tool": "Bash", "arguments": "npm run build", "result": "success", "duration_ms": 4250, "severity": "NORMAL"}
{"timestamp": "2025-01-15T14:32:22Z", "tool": "Bash", "arguments": "git push origin main", "result": "success", "duration_ms": 1820, "severity": "NORMAL"}
{"timestamp": "2025-01-15T14:32:30Z", "tool": "Bash", "arguments": "iptables -A INPUT -s 192.0.2.1 -j DROP", "result": "success", "duration_ms": 45, "severity": "HIGH"}
```

## Example 3: User Prompt Input Validation

Prevents malicious or unsafe prompts from being processed.

### Hook File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit/security-filter.md`

```yaml
---
description: Block potentially malicious user prompts
trigger: before user prompt submitted
---

prompt_text = user_input.text

# Define dangerous patterns
dangerous_patterns = {
  "sql_injection": [
    "DROP TABLE", "DELETE FROM", "INSERT INTO", "UPDATE ",
    "'; --", "\" OR \"", "1=1", "UNION SELECT"
  ],
  "command_injection": [
    "; rm ", "&& rm ", "| rm ", "$(rm ", "`rm ",
    "; curl", "&& curl", "; wget",
    "; nc ", "; bash"
  ],
  "path_traversal": [
    "../../", "..\\", "%2e%2e", "..%2f"
  ],
  "dangerous_commands": [
    "rm -rf /", "DROP DATABASE", "TRUNCATE TABLE",
    "kill -9", "pkill -9", "systemctl stop"
  ]
}

# Scan for patterns
violations = []
FOR (category, patterns) IN dangerous_patterns:
  FOR pattern IN patterns:
    IF pattern (case-insensitive) in prompt_text:
      violations.append({
        "category": category,
        "pattern": pattern
      })

# Action based on violations
IF violations.count > 0:
  BLOCK prompt

  Report:
  "❌ Prompt blocked for security reasons

  Dangerous patterns detected:
  {FOR violation IN violations:
    • [{violation.category}] {violation.pattern}
  }

  If this is legitimate:
  1. Rephrase your request without dangerous keywords
  2. Explain the context/why this is needed
  3. Provide specific file paths (not wildcards)

  Examples of safer alternatives:
  • Instead of 'rm -rf /', use 'remove build artifacts'
  • Instead of 'DROP DATABASE', use 'truncate old logs'
  • Instead of '../../etc/passwd', use 'read home directory config'
  "

  # Log attempt
  log_security_attempt({
    "timestamp": now(),
    "type": "blocked_prompt",
    "violations": violations,
    "prompt_preview": prompt_text[:100],
    "user": current_user
  })

ELSE:
  ALLOW prompt
  Report: "✅ Prompt security check passed"
```

### Configuration Examples

**settings.json**:
```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "user-prompt-submit": [
      {
        "id": "security-filter",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit/security-filter.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Usage Examples

```bash
# Example 1: Malicious SQL injection attempt
User: "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1; --"
Hook Response:
❌ Prompt blocked for security reasons
Dangerous patterns detected:
• [sql_injection] DELETE FROM
• [sql_injection] --

---

# Example 2: Command injection attempt
User: "npm install && rm -rf /"
Hook Response:
❌ Prompt blocked for security reasons
Dangerous patterns detected:
• [command_injection] && rm
• [dangerous_commands] rm -rf /

---

# Example 3: Path traversal attempt
User: "read ../../../etc/passwd"
Hook Response:
❌ Prompt blocked for security reasons
Dangerous patterns detected:
• [path_traversal] ../../

---

# Example 4: Legitimate request - passes
User: "Create a function to validate user input"
Hook Response:
✅ Prompt security check passed
```

## Example 4: Auto-Rollback on Health Check Failure

Automatically rolls back deployment if health checks fail.

### Hook File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/post-tool-use/auto-rollback.md`

```yaml
---
description: Automatically rollback deployment if health checks fail
trigger: after tool Bash(deploy-to-production.sh)
---

# Wait for deployment to stabilize
Wait 60 seconds

# Define health checks
health_checks = [
  {
    "name": "API Health",
    "endpoint": "https://api.example.com/health",
    "timeout_ms": 5000,
    "expected_status": 200,
    "threshold": "response_time <500ms"
  },
  {
    "name": "Error Rate",
    "endpoint": "https://api.example.com/metrics/error_rate",
    "threshold": "<1%"
  },
  {
    "name": "Memory Usage",
    "endpoint": "https://api.example.com/metrics/memory",
    "threshold": "<80%"
  },
  {
    "name": "Database Connection",
    "query": "SELECT 1",
    "timeout_ms": 2000,
    "expected": "success"
  }
]

# Run health checks
results = []
all_passed = true

FOR check IN health_checks:
  TRY:
    IF check.type == "endpoint":
      response = http_get(check.endpoint, timeout: check.timeout_ms)
      passed = response.status == check.expected_status
    ELSE IF check.type == "database":
      response = db_query(check.query, timeout: check.timeout_ms)
      passed = response.success

    results.append({
      "check": check.name,
      "passed": passed,
      "details": response
    })

    IF not passed:
      all_passed = false

  CATCH error:
    results.append({
      "check": check.name,
      "passed": false,
      "error": error.message
    })
    all_passed = false

# Take action based on results
IF all_passed:
  Report:
  "✅ Deployment successful - All health checks passed

  Health Check Results:
  {FOR result IN results:
    • {result.check}: PASSED
  }

  Deployment is healthy and stable."

ELSE:
  Report:
  "❌ Health checks failed - Auto-rollback triggered

  Failed Checks:
  {FOR result IN results WHERE result.passed == false:
    • {result.check}: FAILED ({result.error or result.details})
  }

  Initiating auto-rollback..."

  # Execute rollback
  rollback_result = execute_bash("./scripts/rollback-to-previous.sh")

  IF rollback_result.success:
    Report:
    "✅ Rollback successful - Previous version restored

    Previous version: {previous_version}
    Timestamp: {rollback_time}

    Next steps:
    1. Investigate root cause
    2. Fix issues
    3. Test in staging
    4. Redeploy
    "

    # Alert team
    send_slack_notification(
      channel: "#ops-alerts",
      message: """
      🚨 CRITICAL: Deployment auto-rollback triggered

      Failed checks: {failed_count}/{total_checks}
      Rollback status: SUCCESS

      Deployment rolled back to: {previous_version}
      Time: {rollback_time}

      On-call engineer: please investigate root cause
      Details: {failed_checks}
      """
    )

  ELSE:
    Report:
    "🚨 CRITICAL: Rollback FAILED

    Manual intervention required!

    Current status: DEGRADED
    Previous version restoration: FAILED

    Immediate actions:
    1. Contact on-call engineer
    2. Page incident commander
    3. Check: ./logs/rollback-error.log

    Incident: {incident_id}
    "
```

### Configuration

**settings.json**:
```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "post-tool-use": [
      {
        "id": "auto-rollback",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/post-tool-use/auto-rollback.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "trigger_tools": ["Bash(deploy-to-production.sh)"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Execution Flow

```
Deployment Agent
    ↓
Bash(deploy-to-production.sh)
    ↓
✅ Tool succeeds
    ↓
PostToolUse Hook: auto-rollback triggered
    ↓
Wait 60 seconds for stabilization
    ↓
Run health checks (API, Error Rate, Memory, DB)
    ↓
    ├─ ✅ All checks pass
    │   ↓
    │   Report: "Deployment healthy"
    │
    └─ ❌ Any check fails
        ↓
        Execute rollback script
        ↓
        Rollback succeeds
        ↓
        Alert team (Slack, email)
        ↓
        Report: "Rolled back to previous version"
```

## Example 5: Cost Tracking Hook

Monitors API costs across the session.

### Hook File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/post-tool-use/cost-tracker.md`

```yaml
---
description: Track API costs for budget monitoring
trigger: after MCP tool use
---

# Extract cost info from tool result
tool_name = tool.name
tokens_used = tool.result.metadata.tokens_used || 0
cost_usd = tool.result.metadata.cost_usd || calculate_cost(tool_name, tokens_used)

# Initialize or load session costs
session_costs_file = ".claude/sessions/{session_id}/costs.json"
IF file_exists(session_costs_file):
  session_costs = load_json(session_costs_file)
ELSE:
  session_costs = {
    "session_id": session_id,
    "start_time": now(),
    "budget_usd": 100,
    "tools": []
  }

# Add this tool's cost
session_costs.tools.append({
  "timestamp": now(),
  "tool": tool_name,
  "tokens": tokens_used,
  "cost_usd": cost_usd
})

# Calculate totals
total_cost = sum(tool.cost_usd for tool in session_costs.tools)
budget = session_costs.budget_usd
remaining = budget - total_cost
percent_used = (total_cost / budget) * 100

# Save updated costs
save_json(session_costs_file, session_costs)

# Determine alert level
alert_level = "normal"
IF percent_used > 90:
  alert_level = "critical"
ELSE IF percent_used > 75:
  alert_level = "warning"
ELSE IF percent_used > 50:
  alert_level = "caution"

# Report
IF alert_level == "normal":
  Report:
  "✅ Cost logged
  Tool: {tool_name}
  Cost: ${cost_usd:.2f}
  Session total: ${total_cost:.2f} ({percent_used:.0f}% of budget)
  Remaining: ${remaining:.2f}"

ELSE IF alert_level == "caution":
  Report:
  "⚠️ Cost logged - Budget halfway used
  Tool: {tool_name}
  Cost: ${cost_usd:.2f}
  Session total: ${total_cost:.2f} ({percent_used:.0f}% of budget)
  Remaining: ${remaining:.2f}

  Tip: Consider batching requests to save costs"

ELSE IF alert_level == "warning":
  Report:
  "⚠️⚠️ Cost warning - Budget 75% used
  Tool: {tool_name}
  Cost: ${cost_usd:.2f}
  Session total: ${total_cost:.2f} ({percent_used:.0f}% of budget)
  Remaining: ${remaining:.2f}

  Consider using cheaper alternatives:
  • Batch multiple queries
  • Use caching
  • Switch to cheaper model
  • Use fallback data source"

ELSE IF alert_level == "critical":
  Report:
  "🚨 CRITICAL - Budget 90% used
  Tool: {tool_name}
  Cost: ${cost_usd:.2f}
  Session total: ${total_cost:.2f} ({percent_used:.0f}% of budget)
  Remaining: ${remaining:.2f}

  Immediate action needed:
  1. Consider pausing expensive operations
  2. Switch to cheaper models/tools
  3. Request budget increase
  4. Review cost breakdown below"

  # Show cost breakdown
  Report:
  "Cost breakdown by tool:
  {FOR tool_type, cost IN group_by_tool(session_costs.tools):
    • {tool_type}: ${cost:.2f}
  }"
```

### Generated Cost Report

**File**: `.claude/sessions/session_abc123/costs.json`

```json
{
  "session_id": "session_abc123",
  "start_time": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
  "budget_usd": 100,
  "tools": [
    {
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:05:30Z",
      "tool": "Context7",
      "tokens": 2500,
      "cost_usd": 0.05
    },
    {
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:06:15Z",
      "tool": "Perplexity",
      "tokens": 5000,
      "cost_usd": 0.15
    },
    {
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:07:45Z",
      "tool": "Firecrawl",
      "tokens": 1000,
      "cost_usd": 0.08
    },
    {
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:15:30Z",
      "tool": "Context7",
      "tokens": 3500,
      "cost_usd": 0.07
    }
  ],
  "summary": {
    "total_cost": 0.35,
    "remaining": 99.65,
    "percent_used": 0.35
  }
}
```

## Configuration Best Practices

### Claude Code Settings File

**Location**: `.claude/hooks/settings.json`

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "enabled": true,
    "session-start": [
      {
        "id": "project-init",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/session-start/project-init.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "timeout_ms": 5000
      }
    ],
    "user-prompt-submit": [
      {
        "id": "security-filter",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit/security-filter.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": true,
        "timeout_ms": 1000
      }
    ],
    "pre-tool-use": [
      {
        "id": "quality-gate",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/pre-tool-use/quality-gate.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": true,
        "trigger_tools": ["Bash(git commit)", "Bash(npm run deploy)"]
      },
      {
        "id": "approval-check",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/pre-tool-use/approval-check.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": true,
        "trigger_tools": ["Bash(delete-user", "Bash(drop-database"]
      }
    ],
    "post-tool-use": [
      {
        "id": "audit-logger",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/post-tool-use/audit-logger.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": false,
        "timeout_ms": 2000
      },
      {
        "id": "auto-rollback",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/post-tool-use/auto-rollback.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": false,
        "trigger_tools": ["Bash(deploy-to-production.sh)"],
        "timeout_ms": 65000
      },
      {
        "id": "cost-tracker",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/post-tool-use/cost-tracker.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": false,
        "trigger_tools": ["MCP:*"]
      }
    ],
    "subagent-stop": [
      {
        "id": "aggregate-results",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/subagent-stop/aggregate-results.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": false
      }
    ],
    "session-end": [
      {
        "id": "final-report",
        "file": ".claude/hooks/session-end/final-report.md",
        "enabled": true,
        "blocking": false
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Summary of Examples

| Hook | Type | Purpose | Use Case |
|------|------|---------|----------|
| **Quality Gate** | PreToolUse | Block commits with low coverage | CI/CD Quality |
| **Audit Logger** | PostToolUse | Log all tool executions | Compliance |
| **Security Filter** | UserPromptSubmit | Block malicious input | Security |
| **Auto-Rollback** | PostToolUse | Monitor deployment health | Incident Response |
| **Cost Tracker** | PostToolUse | Track API usage costs | Budget Control |
